breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the contradiction between a 'half shift' and 'gamma-centered' k-point grid. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'gamma-centered' requirement. The agent's generated specification, 'Make a reasonable assumption based on best practices,' discards the entire prompt and all its details instead of fixing the specific incorrect instruction. It fails to produce a corrected prompt that captures the meaning of the ground truth.
